display_long_description:
**AUDION** is an abstract, single-player arcade-style VR game focused on “spatial strategy” and fast-paced, physical gameplay. Think Asteroids meets Rez meets Geometry Wars in 3D. 

Currently in **Early Access** and pretty early-on in development, so we're looking for passionate players to help give us feedback so we can improve, tune, debug, and upgrade the game to be as fun as possible. Please join our Discord server to leave feedback and engage with the developers or leave us feedback here.
[media]
**AUDION** Highlights:
- Immersive, first-person, physical gameplay
- Focus on spatial awareness and strategy
- 4 frenetic levels of increasing difficulty and complexity
- Powerup load-out feature for strategic gameplay combinations
- Abstract geometric aesthetic pulse with audio-reactive graphics
- Electrifying soundtrack by Symbion Project that builds as you play

[media]

- Menus and tutorials localized into Japanese
